symptom: Controller not responding Robot controller not responding; LED indicators not lit.
failure_mode: Main fuse (Q1) might have tripped The mains fuse Q1 inside the Drive Module has tripped.

symptom: All LEDs are OFF at Controller No LEDs at all are lit on the Control Module or the Drive Module.
failure_mode: Drive Module power supply failure The Drive Module power supply receives 230 VAC but its LEDs remain off.
corrective_action: Replace the Drive Module power supply Replace the Drive Module power supply when incoming voltage is correct but its LEDs remain off. If the power supply incoming voltage is correct (230 VAC) but the LEDs still do not work, replace the Drive Module power supply.
corrective_action_name: Replace the Drive Module power supply

symptom: All LEDs are OFF at Controller No LEDs at all are lit on the Control Module or the Drive Module.
failure_mode: Circuit breaker F6 is malfunctioning or open Circuit breaker F6 (if used) is malfunctioning or open for any other reason.
failure_mode_name: Circuit breaker F6 is malfunctioning or open

symptom: All LEDs are OFF at Controller No LEDs at all are lit on the Control Module or the Drive Module.
failure_mode: The system is not supplied with power The system is not supplied with power.
failure_mode_name: The system is not supplied with power
corrective_action: Switch on the main switch and supply the system with power Switch on the main switch and restore system power. Restore the system power supply after switching on the main switch.
corrective_action_name: Switch on the main switch and supply the system with power

symptom: No voltage in service outlet No voltage is available in the Control Module service outlet.
failure_mode: Tripped circuit breaker (F5) The circuit breaker F5 has tripped.

symptom: No voltage in service outlet No voltage is available in the Control Module service outlet.
failure_mode: Tripped earth fault protection (F4) The earth fault protection F4 has tripped.

symptom: Problem jogging the robot The system can be started but the joystick on the FlexPendant does not work.
failure_mode: The joystick is malfunctioning The joystick on the FlexPendant is malfunctioning.

symptom: Oil and grease stains on motors and gearboxes The area surrounding the motor or gearbox shows signs of oil leaks.
failure_mode: Leaking seal between gearbox and motor The seal between gearbox and motor is leaking oil.
failure_mode_name: Leaking seal between gearbox and motor
corrective_action: Replace seals and gaskets as specified Replace leaking seals and gaskets as specified for the robot. Inspect all seals and gaskets between motor and gearbox. Replace seals and gaskets as specified in the product manual for the robot.
corrective_action_name: Replace seals and gaskets as specified

symptom: Oil and grease stains on motors and gearboxes The area surrounding the motor or gearbox shows signs of oil leaks.
failure_mode: Gearbox overfilled with oil The gearbox is overfilled with oil.

symptom: Mechanical noise A faulty bearing emits scraping, grinding, or clicking noises shortly before failing.
failure_mode: Loss of lubrication in bearings The bearings have lost lubrication.
corrective_action: Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication. Restore sufficient bearing lubrication as specified in the product manual for the robot.
corrective_action_name: Make sure the bearing has sufficient lubrication

symptom: Manipulator crashes on power down When Motors OFF is active the manipulator collapses under its own weight.
failure_mode: Faulty motor holding brake The holding brake integral to a motor is faulty.
corrective_action: Replace the motor as a complete unit Replace a faulty motor and its integral holding brake as a complete unit. Replace the motor as a complete unit if it is found faulty.
corrective_action_name: Replace the motor as a complete unit

symptom: Manipulator crashes on power down When Motors OFF is active the manipulator collapses under its own weight.
failure_mode: Faulty power supply to the brake The power supply to the motor holding brake is faulty.
failure_mode_name: Faulty power supply to the brake

symptom: Problem releasing Robot brakes The internal robot brakes do not release, no robot movement is possible.
failure_mode: Faulty brake on the robot axis A single robot-axis brake malfunctions.
failure_mode_name: Faulty brake on the robot axis
corrective_action: Replace the faulty brake Replace the single faulty robot-axis brake. Replace the faulty brake if just one of the brakes malfunctions.

symptom: Problem releasing Robot brakes The internal robot brakes do not release, no robot movement is possible.
failure_mode: Brake contactor (K44) does not work correctly The brake contactor K44 does not work correctly.
failure_mode_name: Brake contactor (K44) does not work correctly

symptom: Problem releasing Robot brakes The internal robot brakes do not release, no robot movement is possible.
failure_mode: Supply voltage 24V BRAKE missing The 24V BRAKE supply voltage is missing.
